info.name: fiskaly E-INVOICE BE 2026-06-01
info.description:
This postman collection consists the basic workflow of E-INVOICE (Version 2026-06-01) including Peppol e-invoicing. Further information is provided in the [developer documentation](https://developer.fiskaly.com/api/e-invoice-be/2026-05-04).

When this collection is executed with Postman, important parts of the results will be stored in the current selected Postman environment.

**Key Features:**

- E-Invoicing System setup for Belgium (BE)
    
- Peppol Proof of Ownership upload
    
- System commissioning workflow
    
- E-Invoice transmission with Peppol recipients
    
- E-Invoice transmission with email recipients
    
- E-Invoice correction transmission
    

**Requirements:**

- Belgium fiscalization credentials (MYMINFIN)
    
- Peppol Proof of Ownership document

item.name: systems (E_INVOICE_SERVICE)

request.description:
Create a System::E_INVOICE_SERVICE. This system is used for e-invoicing and Peppol transmission.

**Note:** Only one E_INVOICE_SERVICE system is allowed per Taxpayer.
Retrieve an E-Invoice System by ID

exec: pm.test("Contains error log about missing proof of ownership", function () {

request.description:
Attempt to commission E-Invoice System without proof of ownership.

**Result:** System will be in COMMISSIONED state but DEGRADED mode. Proof of ownership is required to move to OPERATIVE mode.
List Systems filtered by Taxpayer ID

item.description: E-Invoice Service System management. E_INVOICE_SERVICE systems are used for transmitting e-invoices through Peppol.

item.name: records (Peppol Proof of Ownership)

request.description:
Upload Peppol Proof of Ownership document.

**Important:** This can only be done when the E_INVOICE_SERVICE system is in DEGRADED mode.

**Review Process:** The uploaded proof of ownership document will be reviewed by the service provider. This can take up to 72 hours.

Check the status of the proof of ownership upload.

**Note:** You may need to retry this request with delays until state is COMPLETED.
Retrieve the result record of the proof of ownership upload (UPLOAD::PEPPOL_PROOF_OF_OWNERSHIP)

Commission the E-Invoice System after successful proof of ownership upload.

**Result:** System will be in COMMISSIONED state and OPERATIVE mode, ready to transmit e-invoices.

Retrieve the E-Invoice System and verify the Peppol ID annotation.

After successful proof of ownership, the system will have a `peppol_id` in its annotations.

item.description: Upload Peppol Proof of Ownership document and commission the E-Invoice System. This is required before transmitting e-invoices through Peppol.
